name: dsh-pty-build
description: Pinned, integrity-verified dependency tree for the node-pty native-addon compile in the dsh-hardened builder stage. The committed package-lock.json is the source of truth; the Dockerfile installs it with `npm ci`, which both verifies the node-pty tarball by integrity hash and runs its build script to compile pty.node from source (node-pty ships no Linux prebuild).
